plan.analysis: Inclusion is the weak class (recall 0.346, 117/179 missed): misses are small (median 34px vs 90px train), faint, thin dark vertical streaks, often double. Round 2's 0.5-1.2 range helped vs round 1's 0.3-0.8 (tiny pastes unlearnable), so keep min >=0.4 but bias small and curate thin/faint sources (100,106,131,268,277,50,150,11), dropping the bright 297 and blobby 99. Patches regressed (0.66->0.613) when scale range was raised to 0.5-1.1; misses are small (53px) so revert to round-1's 0.4-0.9 with all sources. Scratches misses are thin short lines (41px), incl. double lines and bright cores; curate thin sources and use 0.4-0.9. Allocation keeps inclusion at ~80 cumulative (diminishing-return threshold) while un-starving patches/scratches.
plan.rationale: Inclusion: match faint thin-streak appearance with curated sources, small-but-learnable scales (0.4-1.0), 25 imgs to reach ~80 cumulative. Patches: revert to the smaller 0.4-0.9 range that gave best recall (0.66) since 0.5-1.1 caused regression; 15 imgs to un-starve. Scratches: thin-line sources only, 0.4-0.9 to produce short thin pastes matching misses; 10 imgs. Total = 50; all within headroom and caps; every class >=10.

plan.analysis: Preview check: Inclusion pastes are thin, faint streaks (mixed orientation after rotation) matching the missed small faint vertical double-streaks. Patches pastes are dark blobs/spots matching the missed low-contrast dark patches. Scratches pastes are thin short lines matching the missed thin lines. Sizes look small-to-medium (prefer_small + 0.4-0.9/1.0 ranges), appropriate for the small misses. No unrealistic feathering, no wrong-class looks, no class wasted (inclusion worst class gets most). Plan is sound; repeat unchanged.
plan.rationale: Previews match missed appearances per class (thin faint streaks / dark blobs / thin lines) at small-to-medium scales; no unrealistic or useless pastes. Keep inclusion highest (worst recall, ~80 cumulative), patches reverted to 0.4-0.9 to recover from round-2 regression, scratches thin-line sources. Total 50, within headroom/caps, all classes >=10.
